context: We anticipate ____ the migration next quarter.
explanation: anticipate 後面接動名詞，不接不定詞。要用不定詞請改用 expect to finish。

distractorExplanations.b: 這是中文母語者最常見的錯誤：anticipate 不接 to + 原形。
distractorExplanations.c: 缺少任何動詞形式標記，語法不成立。
distractorExplanations.d: to 與動名詞不能這樣並用。

prompt: Which sentence uses the correct structure?

options.text: We allocated three servers to the analytics team.
We allocated the analytics team with three servers.
We allocated for the analytics team three servers.
We allocated three servers of the analytics team.

explanation: allocate 的句型是 allocate + 資源 + to + 接受者。

distractorExplanations.b: allocate 不搭配 with 引出資源，這是常見的誤用。
distractorExplanations.c: 語序錯誤，且 allocate 不接 for 引出接受者。
distractorExplanations.d: of 表示所屬關係，無法表達分配動作。

context: The current server is adequate ____ our traffic.
explanation: adequate 接名詞時用 for；接動詞時用 to + 原形（adequate to handle the load）。

distractorExplanations.b: to 只用於 adequate to + 原形動詞的結構，後面不能直接接名詞。
distractorExplanations.c: with 不與 adequate 搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: of 不與 adequate 搭配。

options.text: Ensure that every request carries a trace id.
Ensure every request to carry a trace id.
Ensure to every request a trace id.
Ensure about every request carrying a trace id.

explanation: ensure 後面接 that 子句（that 可省略）或名詞，是標準的技術文件句型。

distractorExplanations.b: ensure 不接「受詞 + to 不定詞」的結構。
distractorExplanations.c: 語序錯誤，ensure 也不接雙受詞。

options.text: The two main emphases of the report are cost and risk.
The two main emphasis of the report are cost and risk.
The two main emphasises of the report are cost and risk.
The two main emphasis's of the report are cost and risk.

explanation: emphasis 的複數是 emphases，與 analysis→analyses 同一種希臘語變化。

distractorExplanations.b: emphasis 是單數形，不能搭配 two 與 are。
distractorExplanations.c: emphasises 是動詞 emphasise 的第三人稱單數形，不是名詞複數。
distractorExplanations.d: 撇號用於所有格，不用於構成複數。

context: All services must comply ____ the retention policy.
explanation: comply 是不及物動詞，固定搭配 with。相對地，conform 才搭配 to。

distractorExplanations.b: comply to 是常見錯誤；to 屬於 conform 的搭配。
distractorExplanations.c: for 不與 comply 搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: on 不與 comply 搭配。

context: Most of the improvement can be attributed ____ caching.
explanation: attribute A to B 的句型在被動語態中同樣保留 to。

distractorExplanations.b: 被動語態的 by 用來表示執行動作者，但這裡要表達的是歸因對象。
distractorExplanations.c: with 不與 attribute 搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: from 表示來源，屬於 derive 的搭配。

context: Version control is indispensable ____ any team of more than one person.
explanation: indispensable 接名詞時用 to（或 for），表示「對……不可或缺」。

distractorExplanations.b: of 不與 indispensable 搭配。
distractorExplanations.c: on 不與 indispensable 搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: in 用於表示範圍，不表達「對某人不可或缺」。

options.text: The tool enables us to deploy faster.
The tool facilitates us to deploy faster.
The tool facilitates us deploying faster.
The tool facilitates for us to deploy faster.

explanation: facilitate 不能接「人 + to do」。要表達「使某人能夠做某事」必須用 enable somebody to do。

distractorExplanations.b: 這是 facilitate 最常見的誤用，其受詞只能是過程而非人。
distractorExplanations.c: facilitate 同樣不接「人 + 動名詞」。
distractorExplanations.d: facilitate 不搭配 for + 不定詞結構。

options.text: The release was deteriorated the performance.
Performance was deteriorated by the release.

explanation: deteriorate 是不及物動詞，主詞自己變差，不能帶受詞。

distractorExplanations.b: deteriorate 不能接受詞；要表達「使……變差」請用 degraded。
distractorExplanations.c: 語法錯誤：被動語態後面又接了受詞。
distractorExplanations.d: 不及物動詞沒有被動語態。

context: That concern is tangential ____ today's decision.
explanation: tangential 固定搭配 to，來自幾何學中「切線碰到曲線」的意象。

distractorExplanations.b: for 不與 tangential 搭配。
distractorExplanations.c: with 不與 tangential 搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: from 表示來源，語意不符。

prompt: Which sentence is preferred in careful technical writing?

options.text: This layout is better than the previous one.
This layout is more optimal than the previous one.
This layout is optimaler than the previous one.
This layout is most optimal than the previous one.

explanation: optimal 本身就是「在給定條件下最好的」，沒有程度之分，因此比較時應改用 better。

distractorExplanations.b: more optimal 在技術寫作中會被視為用語不嚴謹。
distractorExplanations.c: optimal 沒有 -er 比較級形式。
distractorExplanations.d: 最高級不能與 than 連用，語法也不成立。
